mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (user_id, type, block_id, playlist_id, title, note, actor_nickname) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{blockId}, #{playlistId}, #{title}, #{note}, #{actorNickname})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId}
